intro: Excel for digital media buyers on Mac is the engine behind every successful campaign analysis. You spend your day juggling ROAS, CPA, and spend data across platforms like Meta and Google, and Excel is where that data becomes actionable.
tldr: Use keyboard shortcuts to navigate large campaign datasets quickly.
Standardize your UTM tagging and tracking links using formulas.
Leverage Lazur to ask questions about complex spreadsheet functions.
Keep your data clean by removing duplicates and using data validation.
Master the pivot table to summarize cross-platform performance in seconds.

stats.label: Average weekly time spent in spreadsheets

blocks.text: Efficiency starts with your fingers. When you are deep in a campaign report, reaching for the trackpad slows you down. Use these native shortcuts to stay in the flow. Press ⌘ + T to turn your selected data into a formatted table. This helps with filtering and sorting. Press ⌘ + D to fill down the formula in your active cell to the rest of the column. To edit a cell without clicking, press Fn + F2. These small time savings add up when you are managing dozens of ad accounts.

Media buyers often pull raw data from ad platforms that is messy. You might see duplicate rows or inconsistent date formats. Use the Data tab in the ribbon to remove duplicates. Select your campaign ID column and click Data > Remove Duplicates. If you are dealing with text that should be numbers, use the Text to Columns feature. This is under Data > Text to Columns. It is helpful for fixing IDs that Excel converted to scientific notation.

You do not need to be a programmer to build useful reports. Start with basic math to calculate your metrics. Define your CPA as Total Spend divided by Total Conversions. Use the IFERROR function to clean up your reports. If a cell has a divide by zero error, IFERROR lets you display a zero or a dash instead. This makes your reports look professional when shared with clients.

items: Use XLOOKUP to pull campaign names from a master list.
Use COUNTIFS to see how many ads are running in a specific region.
Use Conditional Formatting to highlight rows where ROAS is below your target.
Create a named range for your monthly budget caps to make formulas readable.

blocks.text: Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It does not click buttons for you, but it acts as a guide. When you are stuck on a complex formula, hold the shortcut and ask. Lazur can explain the syntax of a function out loud. If you cannot find a specific setting in the Excel ribbon, ask Lazur where it is. It will draw a circle around the button on your screen.

faq.question: Can I use Excel for Mac for all my reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. Excel for Mac handles large datasets and complex formulas just like the Windows version. It is a standard tool for media buyers.

faq.question: What should I do if my Excel for Mac is slow?
faq.answer: Check your workbook size. If you have many complex formulas, try converting them to static values. Also, ensure you are using the latest version of Microsoft 365.
